posts.text: The ADHD urge to completely reinvent your system instead of using it.
ADHD in women is often misdiagnosed because we call it ‘being emotional.’ Anyone else feel this?
With ADHD, I don’t start when I should—I start when it’s almost too late.
Once I stopped comparing my focus to others, I started thriving.
I realized my ADHD turns motivation into mystery and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.
I start with the tiniest move. If it feels impossible, I’ll just open the tab or put one thing away
